full_judgment: 8. Learned Advocate for the petitioner Mr. Md. Ali Reaz, appearing along with the learned Advocate Mr. Najmul Karim, having placed the petition and drawing my attention to the pleadings, the materials on record (lower Court's record), first of all submits that the impugned deed No.1219 dated 17.2.2008 (Exhibit-I of the plaintiff Exhibit-Ka of the defendants), was obtained by the defendants, while the executants Mahbub Alam (plaintiff) was a minor and also by way of coercion by detaining him in unlawful custody of the defendants and by making false assurance of giving consideration money of Tk.I,60,000.00 (one lac sixty thousand) and thus got the deed registered only on payment of Tk.14.000.00 (fourteen thousand). He mainly emphasized, in his argument, that the plaintiff was a minor at the relevant time and this has been proved by his mother Shirina Akhter; who had filed the aforesaid Title Suit No.62 of 2011, as next friend and in support of his submission, the learned Advocate for the petitioner has referred to a testimonial issued on 3 1.12.2002, by Alipur Government Primary School, in which his date of birth of the plaintiff was shown as 04.6.1992. He next referred to a photocopy of an application for admission, for the year 2003, signed by aforesaid Shirina Akhter, in which the date of birth of Mohammad Mahbub Alam Khan has been shown as 04.6.1992. This has been marked as Exhibit-3. The learned Advocate therefore, concludes that the date of birth of the executants Mahbub Alain Khan (plaintiff) is 04.6.1992 and he was a minor on the date of execution of the impugned deed No.1219 dated 17.2.2008. The learned Advocate for the petitioner has also referred to a Nikahnama of the mother of the plaintiff i.e. Shirina Akhter (marked as Exhibit-4), wherein the date of registration of marriage of his mother Shirina Akhter has been shown in Column No.24, as on 15.6.1990. He, therefore, submits that according to this Nikahaama and the date of registration of marriage of his mother, the executants Mahbub Alum cannot be treated as a major and as such all the documents clearly proved that at the time of registration of the impugned document, the executants Mahbub Alam was a minor. Next, referring to the Exhibit-5, which is a photocopy of the application for deleting the name of the executants Mahbub Alam from the voter list, Filed by his mother, on the ground that "কম বয়সের ছেলেকে বেশী বয়স দেখানো হয়েছে।. This application has been made by his mother Shirinal Akhter. Accordingly, he continues, considering all the documentary evidence along with the oral evidence of the plaintiff witnesses (PW I to PW4), the trial Court has rightly decreed the suit by the judgment and decree dated 20.6.2011. He also submits that there was no ground justifying the reversal of the trial Courts judgment by the Appellate Court in passing the impugned judgment and decree. He next submits that the Nikahnama, Exhibit-4, that recorded the date of registration of marriage of Shirina Akhter was not at alt discussed by the learned Appellate Court, nor any finding was given on that document and for this defect alone the impugned judgment and decree of the Appellate Court is liable to be set aside. In support of his submission, the learned Advocate fot the petitioner referred to the case of Hajee Abul Hossain and others Vs. Md. Amjad Hossain and others: 8 LG (AD) 10 and Abdullah and others Vs. Abdul Karim and others: 20 DLR (SC) 206. Accordingly, he prays for making the Rule absolute.
